errors.text: The proposed athermal nucleation at solute clusters contradicts the target mechanism: nucleation begins at vacancy clusters or disordered atoms and is facilitated by temperature-dependent atomic vibrations.
The prediction of weak temperature dependence conflicts with the pronounced decrease in yield strength from cryogenic conditions to 600 K.
The claim that behavior is effectively independent of orientation conflicts with strong crystallographic anisotropy and maximum yield stress along the <-111> direction.
The proposed strain-rate range of 10^-4 to 10^3 s^-1 does not reconstruct the molecular-dynamics regime of 10^8 to 10^10 s^-1, within which rate insensitivity was specifically bounded.
